description.summary: the material tier of each output

protocol.description:
The material tier of an output, for the shell's overlay surfaces: m0, opaque; m1, glass over the wallpaper blurred once; m2, live blur drawn by the compositor through ext_background_effect_manager_v1. The compositor measures each output's frame time to choose it (doc_visual_language.md VL13). The compositor offers the manager only to the clients it trusts with it; it is Athanor's own protocol (doc_own_stack.md decision 35).
A new version adds interfaces, requests, events or enum entries; a client binds the version it knows.

interface.name: athanor_material_manager_v1
interface.description: Makes the tier object of an output.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The tier objects made from the manager stay valid.

request.name: get_tier
request.description: Makes the tier object of an output. It sends the output's tier at once.

interface.name: athanor_material_v1
interface.description: The tier of one output. An output is m0 until the compositor has measured it, when the compositor renders in software, and when its measurement failed or did not finish. An output the compositor no longer shows is m0.

entry.name: m1
entry.summary: glass over the wallpaper blurred once

entry.name: m2
entry.summary: live blur, drawn by the compositor

event.name: tier
event.description: Sent when the object is made and at each change of the output's tier.
